content: "A key concept in technical analysis is the concept of 'relative strength'. This involves selecting investments that have been outperforming the market, with the expectation that this trend will continue. By focusing on the relative strength of individual stocks or sectors, investors can gain a deeper understanding of market dynamics and make more informed decisions. In a diversified portfolio, relative strength can be a valuable tool for identifying areas of growth and potential for long-term returns. #TechnicalAnalysis #RelativeStrength #Investing"
